Live tool · MCP-powered ## Quick Audit Drop a bank or card-network FX rate. We hit our MCP `check_fx_rate` tool, compare against live mid-market, and hand you the closing line. - Live mid-market via Twelve Data + Perplexity verification - Spread in bps + dollar loss per $1M traded - Same engine OpenAI is reviewing for ChatGPT Apps Base Quote Bank rate offered Run Quick Audit New · MCP tool: compare\_fx\_sources ## Multi-Source FX Comparison Stack your bank rate against mid-market and (optionally) Stripe's live FX Quotes API. Side-by-side proof of every basis point of markup. Bank name Amount Stripe API Key (optional · session only) Never persisted. Sent to Stripe FX Quotes API only for this comparison. Run Comparison Uses base/quote/bank rate from the Quick Audit form above. Run a comparison to see your bank vs Stripe vs mid-market side-by-side. Perplexity-validated · 2025 ## The formulas behind the score Spread formulas verified live via Perplexity sonar against regulator data and official disclosures. No black box — show your prospect the math. ### Retail bank FX rates vs interbank mid-market (BMO, RBC, TD, Scotia, BNC, Chase, BofA, Wells Fargo) `Retail Rate = Mid-Market Rate × (1 + Bank Spread Factor)` 20–100 bps (0.2–1%) Spread varies by currency pair and client type; majors like USD/CAD typically 20-50 bps. [bankofcanada.ca](https://www.bankofcanada.ca/rates/exchange/) [federalreserve.gov](https://www.federalreserve.gov/releases/h10/current/) ### Card-network FX (Amex, Visa, Mastercard) vs mid-market `Card FX Rate = Mid-Market Rate × (1 + Network Markup + Issuer Markup + Foreign Transaction Fee)` 100–500 bps (1–5%) Total effective spread often 3-5%; network rates updated daily with \~1-2% markup over mid. [usa.visa.com](https://usa.visa.com/support/consumer/travel-support/exchange-rate-calculator.html) [mastercard.com](https://www.mastercard.com/global/en/personal/foreign-exchange-rates.html) ### Wire transfer / SWIFT vs mid-market (typical bank spread + lifting fees) `Wire Rate = Mid-Market Rate × (1 + Bank Spread + Lifting Fee Factor)` 50–300 bps (0.5–3%) Includes 3-5 intermediary 'lifts' at $20-50 each, equating to 10-50 bps extra. [swift.com](https://www.swift.com/standards/swift-mystandards) [federalreserve.gov](https://www.federalreserve.gov/paymentsystems/fedach_about.htm) ### Fintech FX (Wise, Revolut, OFX) vs mid-market `Fintech Rate = Mid-Market Rate × (1 + Fintech Spread)` 3–60 bps (0.03–0.6%) Wise uses mid-market + 0.35-0.6% avg; Revolut tiered by plan, near mid for premium. [wise.com](https://wise.com/gb/pricing/) [revolut.com](https://www.revolut.com/legal/fees/) MCP · Perplexity · ChatGPT Ready ## Plug iPayX into any MCP client Your prospects can call `check_fx_rate`,`audit_transaction` and`full_forensic_report` directly from Perplexity, ChatGPT, Claude Desktop, or any MCP-compatible agent. MCP Server URL `https://mcp.ipayx.ai/mcp` Copy #### 1Open your MCP client settings Perplexity Pro → Settings → Connectors. ChatGPT → Apps & Connectors. Claude Desktop → MCP servers. #### 2Add a new HTTP MCP server Name it `iPayX FX Audit` and paste the URL above. #### 3Ask in natural language `"Audit this BMO USD/CAD wire at 1.4350 and tell me the spread vs mid-market."` Read-only · No auth JSON-RPC 2025-03-26 OpenAI Apps in review Audit History ## Recent verifications Live feed of the last quotes verified through this widget.
